searchText: Hi, sorry if this is not the right place to ask - is there any resource on the tech details of how Eth PoS works, other than reading the code? Thank you. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/ Still *highly* technical, but has English language descriptions for stuff. Thanks! two more accesible ones: https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec https://eth2book.info/altair/ Oh wow those seem very helpful. First time I've heard of them today. Thanks!
